# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 16
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Ryl. 463 + P.Oxy 3525 (Greek fragments) | Coptic/Greek
**Chapter:** 16

---

*[Chapter 16 represents material preserved only in the Greek papyrus fragments P.Ryl. 463 and P.Oxy 3525. These Greek fragments partially overlap with the Coptic text and partially preserve otherwise lost material. The following is translated from the Greek where it diverges from or supplements the Coptic.]*

**16:1** [Greek fragment P.Ryl. 463:] [...] "...the Good, and the [fullness] of the [All] will be [restored] [...]"

**16:2** [...] And he said to them, "[...] be on guard that no one [lead you] astray [...]"

**16:3** [...] the Son of Man [...] within you [...] follow [...]

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* The Greek fragments at this point are highly lacunose. P.Ryl. 463 preserves only partial lines. Bracketed words follow scholarly reconstructions (Roberts, Till). The material appears to parallel and supplement GMA chapter 5 rather than represent entirely new content.
